name: fogleman/Craft
description: A simple Minecraft clone written in C using modern OpenGL with online multiplayer support via a Python-based server. Minimalist, well-engineered voxel game reference.
score_rationale: 11k stars, widely referenced clean C implementation of a voxel game engine, used extensively as a learning resource despite being inactive since 2014.
summary: Clean C voxel engine with OpenGL rendering and multiplayer support
